body.purpose: Forms, tables, explanations, and working content.

components.name: Primary Credit Button
components.description: Dominant action for starting or confirming credit work.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #17182b; border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 22px; color: #17182b; background: #d8ff36; font: 600 11px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: #f1f0e9; background: #17182b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff6b35; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Ink Button
components.description: Strong supporting action without competing with new credit creation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid #17182b; border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 22px; color: #f1f0e9; background: #17182b; font: 500 11px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #17182b; background: #d8ff36; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff6b35; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Operational Field
components.description: Square financial input with a decisive bottom-rule focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #17182b; font: 500 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-field input { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid #cccbc3; border-bottom: 2px solid #17182b; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 14px; color: #17182b; background: #faf9f4; font: 400 16px 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-field input:focus { border-bottom-color: #ff6b35; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 #ff6b35; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff6b35; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: Flat bordered surface for portfolio summaries and workflow modules.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 240px; border: 1px solid #cccbc3; border-radius: 0; padding: 20px; color: #17182b; background: #faf9f4; box-shadow: none; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-card span { font: 500 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-card strong { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font: 400 48px/1 'Instrument Serif', serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #565661; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: Compact rail destination with an acid active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 72px; height: 55px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; color: #a5a5b2; background: #17182b; font: 500 16px 'DM Mono', monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-nav-item strong { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { color: #17182b; background: #d8ff36; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff6b35; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Label
components.description: Bordered semantic state that remains legible without decorative effects.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #187448; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; color: #187448; background: #faf9f4; font: 500 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-status > span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #187448; }

narrative.overview: Kreditmx treats financial administration as a living operational ledger: disciplined, immediate, and always moving toward the next sound credit decision. Editorial scale and compact financial metadata keep the primary action clear while preserving dense operational context.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial headlines over structured operational grids.
Flat, square surfaces separated by fine rules.
Compact monospace labels for metadata and state.
Acid green reserved for primary action and active navigation.
Orange reserved for focus, urgency, and intentional emphasis.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Acid green marks the strongest action or active state; do not spread it across passive decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Acid green communicates momentum, while orange communicates attention. Never use them interchangeably.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif speaks direction, sans-serif carries work, and monospace reports state.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Operational surfaces remain flat at rest; state is expressed through color, borders, and typography rather than decorative elevation.

dos: Do make the next credit action obvious before secondary portfolio operations.
Do use thin rules and alignment to organize dense financial information.
Do preserve readable contrast and visible keyboard focus on every interactive control.
Do keep mobile navigation compact while retaining accessible names.
donts: Don't add rounded dashboard cards, decorative side tabs, or glowing halos.
Don't use uppercase for sentences or long explanatory text.
Don't use acid green as passive decoration or orange as a substitute for success.
Don't change DOM contracts, field names, calculations, percentages, or workflow behavior to achieve a visual effect.
